title: Guardians of the Ark sicken and die

tellings.quote: Guardians of the art get sick and die very very rapidly
by and large, once they are appointed guardian of the ark, they have a lifespan of about 3 years.
tellings.difference: Told firsthand from interviews; adds cataracts and a lifespan of about 3 years after appointment.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the Ark's guardians at Aksum sickening and dying quickly after appointment.

as_told.title: Ark of the Covenant guardians at Axum with cataracts and short lifespans

plain: The monks chosen to guard the Ark of the Covenant, which is said to be kept at Aksum in Ethiopia, fall ill and die soon after they take up the job. That is what the writer Graham Hancock tells Michels. The first time, he passes it on as something he was told: guardians "get sick and die very very rapidly." Later he tells it as something he learned from his own interviews at Aksum, adding that they get cataracts and that once appointed they live "about 3 years," which, if true, would hint that the object they guard is physically dangerous.
